name: Adolescent with tall stature and joint laxity
note_text: A 14-year-old boy evaluated for chest deformity. Physical exam demonstrates distinct arachnodactyly with elongated digits, marked pectus excavatum, and joint hypermobility. Ophthalmologic examination reveals bilateral ectopia lentis. Transthoracic echocardiogram showed aortic root aneurysm.
